title: Users sometimes see someone else's account
hints: Log currentUser().name before and after each await in the GET /me route, then run the tests.
A module has one copy of its variables, shared by every request the server is handling. What can happen to that copy during an await?
Keep the signed-in user on something that belongs to this one request, such as res.locals.

hiddenTestRules.overlapping requests > keeps a note with: A note always belongs to the person who sent it, even while other requests are running.
hiddenTestRules.overlapping requests > gives each person: Each person only ever gets their own notes.
hiddenTestRules.overlapping requests > answers everyone: Every request is answered for the person whose token it carries, however many run at once.
hiddenTestRules.overlapping requests > does not make a q: One person's slow request must not hold up anyone else's.
hiddenTestRules.overlapping requests > regression: an un: A request with a missing or unknown token is 401 with { error: 'Not signed in' }, even right after someone else's request.
